newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ispat to take over Thyssen long steel.
newsitem.headline: Ispat to take over Thyssen long steel.

text.p: Britain's Ispat International plans to buy two long-steel units from Thyssen Stahl AG, parent company Thyssen AG said on Tuesday.
The two companies reached an agreement in principle on the transfer of Stahl Ruhrort GmbH and Walzdraht Hochfeld GmbH on June 21, Thyssen said.
The agreement is still subject to negotiation of final details and approval by the European Commission, it said.
Ispat is a family-run concern with steel interests scattered around the globe. Thyssen is in the process of merging its steel activities with those of Fried. Krupp Stahl AG Hoesch-Krupp.
Long steel products include beams and rods, as distinguished from flat or wire products.
